body: ac-00 B07 audit: is bigger potion (8M/32M) a drop-in via model2vec_shared (swap model dir + EMBED_DIM/EMBED_AGG_DIM) or needs model2vec-rs? Enumerate EMBED_DIM/EMBED_AGG_DIM/FTMB-embed-slot/config consumers. Define the 27-stats build path for the ac-01 reproducibility baseline (revert the 44-stat column-distribution NO-GO, or add a legacy-stats flag).

ac-00 DONE: bigger-potion embed-swap audit. model2vec-rs NOT needed; Rust loader is dim-agnostic, only EMBED_DIM/EMBED_AGG_DIM consts truncate >128 (embedding_aggregation.rs:14,17). Experimental path is Python-only dim-agnostic (gte build_ftmb_v5_gte.py is the template); native ship is a 2-const bump + model-dir swap + config embed_dim. potion-8M=256d/1024agg, 32M=512d/2048agg, all cached. Build hygiene baked: VALID_DIM gate must assert 244 (overnight gate hardcodes 240, would fail build) + FTMB record-count assert (read_ftmb --verify EOF is only a WARNING). Deliverable: output/embed-frontier/ac00_embed_swap_audit.md

ac-01: build + launch 3-seed Model2Vec reproducible baseline at v19 exact recipe (potion-4M, 27 stats, format v4) with VALID_DIM=244 gate + FTMB record-count guard. Target best-of-3 composed ~0.793, Sense ~0.502, or diagnose the drift gap. This is the movable baseline.

FOLLOW-UP (off critical path): benchmark model2vec-rs vs our hand-rolled candle embed path (model2vec_shared.rs::encode_batch, written 2026-03-01 NNFT-165). Only worth it IF after ac-02 picks a winning potion (4M/8M/32M) embed latency is a larger-than-expected slice of per-column profile cost. Today Model2Vec embed = 0.39 ms/col (~100x faster than gte), NOT the bottleneck, so deferred. RISK to weigh: our path is bit-matched to Python StaticModel.encode() (tests assert) and training features were built that way — adopting model2vec-rs requires re-validating train/inference parity (any pooling/normalisation diff desyncs). Decision criterion: only adopt if measured embed-latency win > the parity-revalidation cost. We do NOT currently depend on the model2vec-rs crate.

REPRODUCIBLE. Best-of-3 Sense 0.521 (beats v19 0.502), composed 0.770 (inside v19 CI [0.767,0.819]). Fresh-retrain penalty was the 44 stats, not the pipeline. Movable baseline = models/repro-baseline-relu-s44. Verdict: output/embed-frontier/ac01_verdict.md
